subject: Journal entry for credit claim VEN025-0020
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record: VEN025-0020
Finding: VEN025-0020 shows in GSTR-2B for 2025-10, not 2025-09.
Why: The supplier reported this invoice one return period late, so its Rs 643 of credit can be claimed only in that month.
Entry to make: Claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.
Amount involved: Rs 643.
